name: Reklamnoe leto
source:
CYCLES? WHAT CYCLES?

Some anomaly occurred, and now life in the camp has shifted from a standstill. Technology advanced, and society began to degrade. Because of this, the camp was fenced off with a wall, which attracted the attention of meme-loving tourists.

Our protagonist was given a very important mission - to shoot a promotional video of this place in order to attract even more memelords.
